scenarios.description: The scripted AI can build a barracks within a bounded tick budget on at least two different map seeds — the build order must generalize across maps rather than overfitting to one seed.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Scripted AI tests pass confirming build-order logic produces a barracks within budget; engine tests confirm the economy/combat loop supports the build path; build order is validated on more than one seed.

scenarios.description: AI soldiers automatically engage enemies within weapons range — the combat micro logic selects valid targets, respects range and cooldown, and does not issue per-tick LLM calls.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Scripted AI tests confirm target selection and range discipline; combat resolution tests pass confirming the micro decisions translate into valid combat outcomes; no per-tick LLM call is present in the agent loop.

scenarios.description: The scout agent explores unknown map regions and updates fog-of-war knowledge without hardcoding map coordinates or seed values.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Scout tests pass confirming the agent explores unknown tiles, respects fog-of-war, and does not hardcode coordinates; the scouting behavior generalizes across at least two seeds.
